top5_quickwins.title: Per-fold asymmetric threshold (different T_up/T_dn per sym)
top5_quickwins.effort: ~20 min (modify DE search to run per-fold)
top5_quickwins.rationale: T39 shows fold 4 optimal T*=0.41 while fold 0 optimal T*=0.39 — a shared threshold is suboptimal. Per-fold (per-sym) thresholds during CV would test ~2 PnL gain. CAVEAT: during inference sym-agnostic needed so would need to use shared, but validates if per-fold model is better.

top5_quickwins.title: Add 3–5 more diverse seeds with different num_leaves
top5_quickwins.rationale: Ensemble diversity audit shows mean pairwise correlation ~0.8+. Adding 2 seeds with num_leaves∈{31,511} and distinct feature_fraction should add 5–10% disagreement rate → PnL uplift from averaging orthogonal errors.

top5_quickwins.title: Train separate h=5 and h=20 models as backup submissions
top5_quickwins.rationale: Competition takes BEST of 5 horizons. If h=60 plateaus at +13.6 (current), a strong h=20 or h=40 model could score independently. h=20 α=0.10% gives 2.7× better fee-to-signal ratio than h=5. Cost: just rerun training.

top5_quickwins.title: Increase augmentation range [0.75, 1.25] → [0.7, 1.3] for low-signal folds
top5_quickwins.rationale: T37 tested [0.75, 1.25] but only got +12.9 vs iter_006 +13.6. Fold 0 and fold 3 are signal-poor — heavier augmentation might improve OOD robustness. T37 DECISION.md says wider aug hurt, but test at fold-0/3 specific setting.

top5_quickwins.title: EV-weighted threshold objective: use Sharpe-of-PnL instead of sum-PnL in DE
top5_quickwins.rationale: Current DE maximizes sum of cum_pnl across folds. Fold 3 drags down with only 247 trades at +0.10 PnL — DE may waste search budget on this noisy fold. A Sharpe-weighted objective could allocate more budget to folds with real signal.
